rules: Runtime graph must visibly contain deterministic helper boundaries where algorithmic verification is required.
Canonical node_context.allowed_tools is used for runtime helper permissions; package-local Python remains declared by verification_profile/python_script rather than an invented Python node type.
Concrete document templates and package assembly contracts must be represented by explicit graph nodes before generic field/materialization processing.
External outputs remain Ordo outputs, but each output must have an explicit materialization/handoff node in the graph.
Raw deterministic tool output is interpreted by AI before user-facing explanation.
